fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Aftercare sent with the signed copy

Email each client a copy of the form they signed, with your aftercare sheet attached, the moment they tap submit. The client keeps both in their inbox for the days after the wax.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
Only the areas Tessa booked, each with its questions

Tessa Moreau books her first Brazilian and an underarm wax at Saltwater Wax Co. Her form asks the questions for those 2 areas and nothing about her face or legs. She answers yes to a recent sunburn, and esthetician Nina Caldwell gets an email the day before with that answer at the top.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { bodyAndBrazilian: "I run Saltwater Wax Co. Build a waxing consent form where the client picks the areas booked, such as Brazilian, underarm, face, or legs, and only sees the questions for those areas. Ask about recent sunburn, retinoid creams, and acne medication. If a client answers yes to any of them, email the esthetician on the booking the day before the appointment.", browWaxAndTint: "My brow bar only tints after a patch test taken at least 48 hours before the appointment. Build a brow wax and tint consent form that checks the client's record for a patch test date. If there is one, open the tint section. If not, show the wax section only and add a link to book a patch test.", teenBrowWaxing: "Build a consent form for my salon that asks for date of birth first. Our policy is that any client under 18 needs a parent signature, so for those clients open a parent section with the parent's name and signature. Save both signatures on the same record, and show me a table of under-18 clients and who is still waiting on a parent.", waxClubMembers: "We run a wax club with 212 members, and every member re-signs our consent once a year. Build the consent form and a member table with each member's last signature date. When a signature has 30 days left, email that member a renewal link, and put the new signature on their record next to the old one." };
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-6-des: Link each signed record to its appointment in the booking software you already use, since Emergent connects to any tool with an API. Have the app email the esthetician on the booking about any yes answer before the client arrives.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a waxing consent form that saves every response to a database I own.
